summary: Ronnie Hill, 64, of Salida, drowned when the private raft he was rowing flipped in the Class III Bear Creek Rapid on the Arkansas River east of Salida; an AHRA ranger patrolling the river rescued a second passenger, and a multi-agency search recovered Hill's body entangled with the overturned raft on an island above Wellsville Bridge; CPR failed.
location: Bear Creek Rapid, Arkansas River east of Salida
responding_agency: CPW Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area rangers; CPW wildlife officers; Salida Fire Department; Chaffee County EMS; Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Fremont County Sheriff's Office; Arkansas Valley Ambulance; Howard Fire Department
notes: CPW AHRA release + Fox 21 report via American Whitewater. Third Arkansas River water death in a week. Run 1017 chunk A.
